bagPolicy.summary: The venue operator says bags are searched at entry and lists bag restrictions in its New York club FAQ. The page mixes answers for several regions, so confirm the specific show’s allowed size before bringing a bag.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The operator says its New York clubs have no designated parking and suggests neighborhood street parking or public transportation.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Music Hall of Williamsburg. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The operator says its clubs have a full bar serving water, soft drinks, beer, wine and spirits; outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue operator asks guests seeking accessible accommodation to alert security on arrival; event pages provide individual door times.
